game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the oasis keeper must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: In Bazaar Tents, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the oasis keeper ahead. Then check the speed value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the sandstone arch by solving code steps involving speed that move the oasis keeper forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the sandstone arch first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Bazaar Tents'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Bazaar Tents.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
